Build me a stylized cyberpunk city fragment at night, floating on an uninterrupted flat pale-blue ground plane with no roads, curbs, vegetation, or terrain detail. At the center, form a dense, irregular cross-shaped cluster of roughly a dozen connected mid-rise blocks, packed tightly into narrow alleys and small open courts. Give these buildings dark brick, gray stucco, and muted red façades, projecting window bays, balconies, exterior stairs, awnings, rooftop sheds, vents, air-conditioning units, railings, and rows of small glowing windows. Line their ground floors with compact storefronts, glass doors, illuminated display windows, and vertical or horizontal East Asian neon signs. Suspend a chunky red-orange futuristic vehicle above one courtyard beside an open concrete frame. Around this compact inner neighborhood, arrange a much looser ring of roughly twenty detached high-rise towers, leaving broad empty blue gaps between them and the center. Most towers should be simple rectangular residential slabs with repetitive bands or grids of bright white-blue windows, varied heights, and dark mechanical rooftop boxes. Add several landmark skyscrapers: cyan-lit glass towers capped by vivid hot-pink geometric crowns, a tall pink-edged tower wrapped in diagonal lattice braces and topped with antenna fins, and a few extremely tall, nearly black monolithic slabs at the outer edges, some leaning into or cropping out of the view. Keep the composition deliberately sparse and surreal outside the crowded core, with towers facing inward in an uneven ring, no continuous street network, and hard scene boundaries created by isolated buildings and oversized dark slabs against a deep navy sky.
